client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID of your Anghami Developer Portal application.

redirect_uri.label: Redirect URI
redirect_uri.description: A Redirect URI registered for your Anghami application. After login you will be redirected here; copy that URL back into Music Assistant.

start_login_label.label: The button below will redirect you to Anghami to authenticate. After authenticating you will be redirected to your Redirect URI; copy the full URL from the address bar and return here.

start_login.label: Authenticate with Anghami
start_login.description: Opens the Anghami login page to start the authentication.

redirected_url_label.label: Paste the full URL you were redirected to (it contains the authorization code) into the field below.

redirected_url.label: Redirected URL
redirected_url.description: The full URL from the address bar after authenticating on Anghami.

complete_login_label.label: After pasting the URL above, click the button below to complete the login.

complete_login.label: Complete authentication
complete_login.description: Exchanges the authorization code for an access token.

expiry_time.label: Expiry time of the Anghami access token

manifest.description: Stream music, playlists and charts from Anghami.
